digest.component_or_area: local LLM configuration and developer gates
propositions: Local rebar gates must be configured to resolve model classes to Bedrock inference profiles before the production cutover in S8 to validate Bedrock compatibility with real gate runs

All three local gates (review-plan, review-code, verify-completion) must execute end-to-end against Bedrock inference profiles with parseable verdicts and nonzero cache_read tokens proving cache engagement
Provider-clean instrumentation must confirm all LLM calls resolve to Bedrock profiles with zero direct-Anthropic calls, validated via REBAR_USAGE_LOG per-call tally
Bedrock cachePoint TTL default parity with Anthropic cache_control (both 5 minutes when unspecified) must be stated with evidence that observable caching behavior does not regress
Local opt-in via REBAR_LLM_CONFIG_FILE and revert to Anthropic baseline must be documented and executionally proven in docs/local-dev-env.md with no infra/ modifications
Structured output validation must hold on all three gates with no verdicts falling back to unparsed or INDETERMINATE shapes due to provider differences
